label.description: Visible label tied to the input.

onValueChange.description: Called on every change with the value and its { level, label, met } score.

rules.description: { id, label, test, remaining? } rules. Strength is the share met across four steps.

error.description: Error copy; sets aria-invalid and shakes the field once per new error.

onRevealedChange.description: Called when the reveal toggle is pressed.

messages.description: Every built-in string, for translation: levels { tooShort, weak, fair, good, strong }, showPassword, meterLabel, noPassword, rulesLabel, ruleMet, ruleNotMet, remainingPrefix, remainingSuffix, and summary({ label, met, total }). Pass only what you change; the rest stay English.

shortLength.description: Below this many characters the meter holds at its first step and reads the tooShort word.

countCharacters.description: How shortLength counts characters. Code points by default (an emoji counts once); pass password => password.length to match a policy that counts UTF-16 units.
